name: Hel
title: Queen of Helheim
summary: Summon the dead to fight for you as your foes fall in battle and empower your attacks.
lore: The Lady of Graves rules over the dead of Asgard who perish of illness and old age. Hers is a joyless domain, but then, she is often a cold and pitiless goddess. But in Ryven, as she negotiates with the mysterious "Shadow Council" formed by Osiris, the lonely Hel finds herself falling in love with a most unlikely figure…
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Enemies under [Shade], inflict 50% more damage when joining with Hel's Basic Attack.
If any enemy is defeated, this hero gain's an Extra Turn.
Each [Shade] that joins the attack will inflict an additional 10% of the target's MAX HP.
